question.text: Audit trail of PMS order activities must include:

answer.text: Time stamping of order placement, execution and allocation

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio managers must maintain an audit trail of fund and securities management activities, including order placement, trade execution and allocation, with time stamping for order placement, order execution and trade allocation. The Trap: Confirmations, emails, or feedback alone do not satisfy the time-stamped audit-trail requirement. Note: Time stamps must cover the full lifecycle from placement to allocation.
